units.unit_name: Rocks on west side include mafic lava flows, formation of Lousy Jim, and tuff of Lion Flat 22 m.y.
Rocks on east side include: mafic gravels of Gunsight Flat 22-23 m.y.; mafic lava flows of Circleville Mtn.; mafic Lava flows of Birch Creek Mtn 22-23 m.y.

units.notes: *Certain widespread distinctive tuff beds from more distant source volcanoes are interlayered with the Mount Dutton rocks of local origin

units.unit_name: Mount Dutton Formation, alluvial and vent facies
units.notes: Mount Dutton Formation, mostly andesite, came from a series of east-west stratovolcanoes located in area of present southern Tushar Mts
26.2 m.y.; quartz latite porphyry; intrudes Claron Fm

units.unit_name: Wah Wah Springs Formation, Needles Range Group

units.notes: Note: Some authors have incorrectly included Oligocene limestones and tuffs within this formation. The Oligocene limestones are unlike those in the Claron, which are typified by mottled yellow & purple beds. No tuffs have been found in the Claron Formation; 60 m.y.; top third-white Claron-fresh-water limy beds; bottom two-thirds red Claron - mostly mudstone, and limy siltstone; Claron Fm was intruded and domed by the Spry laccolith
